propositions: Automated filers set REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable to record the detection channel (canary, CI, review-bot, etc.) at bug creation time.
The --detected-by optional flag on CLI overrides the environment variable; absence of both leaves the field unset in the event.
Detected-by value is normalized by strip and lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum validation.

The process_create reducer projects detected_by additively into compiled state alongside source_* and creation_channel fields; events without detected_by reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior.
The detected_by field is declared as optional in ticket_state.schema.json and documented in env-var registry and agent guidance.
